title: Poem - Silent bloom
shortDescription: Just a short poem I felt like writing out of nowhere
content:
Desire only grows in the garden

I can no longer walk.

Chasing fallen stars that never meant a thing,

the ones that could never shine beside my moon in the night sky.

My lips held back words I couldn’t speak,


Trying to quiet storms no one ever saw.

Your voice still lingers like smoke,

each word a spark in the ruins of my calm.

The mistake I can't undo lies buried

beneath every silent bloom.


I was a flower that couldn’t grow in your garden,

so the wind carried me away.

Now I wither in my own, rootless, aching,

my petals curling where your presence once was.


And still I tend to the emptiness,

watering only shadows,

knowing this garden will never bloom again.
